parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 (background, count, shape, contact, clean and color differ by 1; main is equal), both totals are 28, and neither image has a critical defect.

reference.summary: A brown beaver chef with a sun-patterned apron fries two eggs in a pan on a stove, with a smiling sun in the window. It is cheerful and clear, but the arm is drawn very thin.

defects.what: The arm holding the spatula is an extremely long, thin, noodle-like stretch
defects.where: the beaver's right arm reaching to the pan
defects.expected: A thicker, shorter arm in proportion with the beaver's body

defects.what: The pan is drawn over the back of the stove and does not clearly sit on a burner
defects.where: the pan on the stove top
defects.expected: The pan sits squarely on a burner

defects.what: The big smiling sun in the window and the floating heart compete for attention with the beaver
defects.where: upper left window and above the pan
defects.expected: Background details stay quieter than the beaver and the eggs

defects.what: The caption is pale brown on a brown wood floor and hard to read
defects.expected: The caption contrasts clearly with the floor

attempt.summary: A brown beaver in a chef's hat and apron fries two sunny-side-up eggs in a pan at a kitchen counter. It is clearly drawn, but the spatula and the hand holding it are confusing.

defects.what: The spatula is unclear: a brown stick points up and away from the fist, while a thin grey shaft runs down to a blade floating beside it, so it looks like two separate pieces
defects.where: the beaver's right hand above the pan
defects.expected: One spatula with a single handle held in the fist, running straight to the blade

defects.what: The spatula blade hangs in the air above the pan and does not touch the eggs or the pan
defects.expected: The spatula blade rests in the pan, touching or sliding under an egg

defects.what: The frying pan sits on a wooden counter edge, not on a burner, so it is unclear how the eggs are cooking
defects.expected: The pan sits clearly on a stove burner

defects.what: The reaching arm is stretched very long and thin compared with the body
defects.expected: The arm is in proportion with the beaver's chunky body

defects.what: A stray vertical line runs down the middle of the apron
defects.expected: A clean apron without unexplained lines
